name: edictum
description: Edictum, a multiplayer nation simulator, on Firebase Hosting, Auth and Firestore.

scripts.test:e2e: python3 build.py && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-edictum --only auth,firestore,hosting "node test/e2e.mjs"
scripts.test:smoke: python3 build.py && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-edictum --only auth,firestore,hosting "node test/smoke.mjs"
